documents.text: Refund Policy. Customers may request a full refund within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days, refunds are issued as store credit only. Refunds are processed within 5 business days to the original payment method.
Shipping Policy. Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within India. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs an extra 250 rupees. Orders above 2000 rupees ship free.
Warranty. All hardware products carry a 2 year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and water damage are not covered. Warranty claims require the original invoice.
